Customer Service Representative (French Speaking) Job at Avetium Consult




        
    

        
        Avetium Consult is a Business Process Outsourcing and Technology solution company incorporated in Nigeria. Avetium Consult is what happens when top experts of top multinationals from diverse fields and similar values come together to deliver transformational solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Representative (French Speaking)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Handle inbound and outbound customer calls professionally and efficiently.
	Communicate fluently with customers in French and English.
	Respond to customer enquiries, complaints, and requests promptly.
	Provide accurate information on products, services, and processes.
	Resolve customer issues or escalate complex matters appropriately.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and transactions.
	Follow approved call scripts, procedures, and quality standards.
	Achieve assigned call centre KPIs, including service quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
	Maintain confidentiality of customer and company information.
	Participate in required training and coaching sessions.
	Perform other duties as assigned by the Team Lead.


Job Requirements


	Minimum of OND/NCE or equivalent qualification with 1-3 years of working experience.
	Fluency in French and English, both spoken and written.
	Previous experience in a call centre, customer service, or BPO environment is an advantage.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good listening, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
	Proficiency in using computers and basic customer service applications.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet performance targets.
	Ability to work effectively in a team and adapt to shift schedules.


Salary
N250,000 per month.

	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERPs, and accounting software.
	High mathematical aptitude, attention to detail, and analytical problem-solving capabilities.


Salary
N193,000 monthly.

&nbsp;Job Position: Experience Centre Consultant

Job Locations: Kano, Ibadan - Oyo, and Port Harcourt - Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting To: Store Manager

Job Summary


	The Experience Centre Consultant converts a customer&#39;s energy needs into a tailored power solution through a structured, consultative approach. This is not just a product-push role &mdash; it is a diagnostic advisory role.
	The right candidate starts every conversation with questions, not products, and builds a recommendation around what the customer actually needs.


Responsibilities


	Engage walk-in customers warmly and professionally, and open every interaction with discovery &mdash; understanding the customer&#39;s needs before presenting any solution.
	Design and present tailored energy system recommendations based on each customer&#39;s requirements.
	Generate written quotations for every consultation and present pricing with clarity and confidence.
	Close sales consultatively &mdash; guide the customer to a decision without pressure.
	Coordinate post-sale processes including installation scheduling and customer communication.
	Process payments accurately and issue documentation for every transaction.
	Maintain up-to-date records of all customer interactions, leads, and follow-ups in the CRM.
	Follow up on unconverted leads in a timely and professional manner.
	Maintain the assigned display area in excellent condition at all times.
	Uphold the Simba Den brand and presentation standard on every shift.


Qualifications


	Educational Qualification: Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree or its equivalent in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
	Experience: 1 - 3 years of experience in retail sales.
	Experience in a similar industry will be an added advantage.
	Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
	Knowledge of power backup solutions (inverters, batteries, solar products) is an advantage
	Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations
	Not more than 32 years old.


Skills Requirements:


	Consultative selling ability &mdash; leads with discovery and needs assessment, not product pitches.
	Confident communicator &mdash; able to explain complex technical products in simple, clear language.
	Comfortable engaging high-net-worth and professional customers.
	Self-motivated and target-driven &mdash; tracks own performance and takes initiative.
	Competent with technology &mdash; tablets, digital display systems, and CRM platforms.
	Strong follow-through &mdash; closes the loop on every customer interaction and lead.


Salary

Experience Centre Consultant Job at Simba Group




        
    

        
        Simba Group which started operations in 1988, is a conglomerate having a Pan-Nigeria presence and business interests in some ofthe most dynamic sectors in the economy. The Group is a dominant player in the transportation, powerand IT-enabled service sectors, which are critical to the sustained growth of the Nigerian Economy. The corporate vision of the Group is to provide innovative and quality products along with excellent after-sales service to our customers. The activities of the Group are guided by strong value systems built around Integrity, Innovation, Openness and Consistency. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Experience Centre Consultant
     

            
    



Job Locations: Kano, Ibadan - Oyo, and Port Harcourt - Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting To: Store Manager

Job Summary


	The Experience Centre Consultant converts a customer's energy needs into a tailored power solution through a structured, consultative approach. This is not just a product-push role — it is a diagnostic advisory role.
	The right candidate starts every conversation with questions, not products, and builds a recommendation around what the customer actually needs.


Responsibilities


	Engage walk-in customers warmly and professionally, and open every interaction with discovery — understanding the customer's needs before presenting any solution.
	Design and present tailored energy system recommendations based on each customer's requirements.
	Generate written quotations for every consultation and present pricing with clarity and confidence.
	Close sales consultatively — guide the customer to a decision without pressure.
	Coordinate post-sale processes including installation scheduling and customer communication.
	Process payments accurately and issue documentation for every transaction.
	Maintain up-to-date records of all customer interactions, leads, and follow-ups in the CRM.
	Follow up on unconverted leads in a timely and professional manner.
	Maintain the assigned display area in excellent condition at all times.
	Uphold the Simba Den brand and presentation standard on every shift.


Qualifications


	Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree or its equivalent in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
	Experience: 1 - 3 years of experience in retail sales.
	Experience in a similar industry will be an added advantage.
	Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
	Knowledge of power backup solutions (inverters, batteries, solar products) is an advantage
	Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations
	Not more than 32 years old.


Skills Requirements:


	Consultative selling ability — leads with discovery and needs assessment, not product pitches.
	Confident communicator — able to explain complex technical products in simple, clear language.
	Comfortable engaging high-net-worth and professional customers.
	Self-motivated and target-driven — tracks own performance and takes initiative.
	Competent with technology — tablets, digital display systems, and CRM platforms.
	Strong follow-through — closes the loop on every customer interaction and lead.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.
